name: Wood Bolts & Nuts Screw: Pin Puzzle 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Wood Bolts & Nuts Screw: Pin Puzzle is a logic game where you must strategically unlock screw holes in various products to guide metal plates into place in the correct sequence. This engaging gameplay experience challenges your spatial awareness and problem-solving skills as you work through intricate mazes filled with nuts, bolts, and plates.
